thread:
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] inference-eu-prod p95 latency > 3s for 8m — paging @eu-oncall
jordan: ack, joining bridge
sara: joining, starting live triage
mike: looking at routing + KV cache, any 5xx from customers?
ops-bot: alert: 5 customer-facing requests failed in last 5m, 0 total 5xx (minor)
jordan: customer impact = degraded response times for chat flows, not hard errors
sara: can we route a portion to a smaller model variant as a mitigation? mike can you flip routing?
mike: starting partial fallback to model-x-small in eu (canary) — will update when live
jordan: update: canary warmed, 20% traffic -> model-x-small
ana: FYI +1 customer reported slowdown via support ticket #1234
sara: adding that to postmortem notes
mike: canary reduced p95 to ~900ms, overall p95 now ~1.2s :thumbsup:
jordan: routing change pushed, watching for cache thrash and KV evictions
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary routing config applied by mike @ 2764509400
jordan: seeing KV eviction spikes at 2764509500, ramping cache size on pool now
mike: increased cache size on dedicated pool (ran: kubectl exec -n inference redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory 6gb)
sara: capturing actions -> schedule postmortem, alert cleanup, SLO revisit, runbook updates
jordan: agreed. action items: 1) tune paging thresholds 2) suppress noise during retry storms 3) add canary fallback runbook and warm-up guidance
ana: I'll own postmortem scheduling + customer comms for impacted tenants
ana: proposed postmortem slot Tue 10:00 PT, ping if conflicts
mike: I'll own routing fallback runbook + PR for routing config change
sara: I'll own alert + SLO changes and add evals for regression detection
jordan: creating tracking tickets: INF-431 (routing fallback runbook), INF-432 (alert tuning & suppressor), INF-433 (cache sizing autoscale)
ana: created INF-431, INF-432, INF-433 and linked support ticket #1234
ops-bot: incident-bot: severity lowered to SEV2 @ 2764511200, bridge closed @ 2764511800
jordan: quick retro note: current p95 threshold too tight for transient retry storms; page triggered during an auto-retry burst
sara: proposal: require 5m sustained p95 degradation AND error-rate > 0.5% before paging; also add a short suppressor that ignores spikes driven by client retries
mike: draft alert snippet for Prometheus style rule:
```
alert: HighInferenceLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(inference_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 2.5
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: /runbooks/inference-latency
```
sara: and add a companion rule to check retry storm signal, label pages with suppressed_by_retry_storm when retries > 1000/5m
ana: I'll add postmortem doc template and assign owners to each INF ticket
jordan: thanks everyone — we'll do a short async retro in #incidents tomorrow and keep the INF tickets as the source of truth for follow-ups
sara: :thumbsup: closing incident thread here but keeping followups in the INF tickets and postmortem doc
